visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with a high, dark brown ponytail and dramatic evening makeup stands in the middle of a bustling urban intersection at night. She wears a floor-length, gradient sequined dress that transitions from black at the top to a bronze-purple hue at the hem, featuring a plunging deep V-neckline. She poses with her hands on her hips, looking off-camera with a neutral expression. The background is a wash of bright city lights, neon advertisements, and the blurred silhouettes of passing cars and pedestrians. (2) The scene shifts slightly as she turns her head to look directly into the lens, offering a subtle, confident smirk. A pair of large, teardrop-shaped crystal earrings catch the artificial light. In the background, a large digital billboard displays a blue and white advertisement, while an Adidas store logo is clearly visible on a nearby building. A hand briefly enters from the right edge of the frame to adjust a stray strand of her hair before disappearing. (3) The camera moves closer for a series of tight shots focusing on her face and torso as she continues to shift her weight and pose. The lighting is high-contrast, casting sharp highlights on her skin and the shimmering sequins of her dress. The background bokeh turns the streetlights into soft, glowing orbs. She maintains a flirtatious and commanding presence, occasionally looking down and then back up at the viewer. (4) The woman turns her back to the camera and begins walking through the crosswalk towards a crowd of people. The camera follows her at a medium full-shot distance, capturing the sway of the sequined gown. She looks back over her right shoulder one last time, tossing her ponytail as she disappears into the urban nightscape. The street is wet, reflecting the colorful neon signs above.
